name: Telegram
description: Messaging platform with a free HTTPS Bot API (and lower-level MTProto client API) for building bots and integrations.
access_notes: Fully self-serve and free: message @BotFather, run /newbot, and receive a bot authentication token immediately. Token is embedded in the request URL (https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/METHOD). The separate MTProto client API also has self-serve api_id/api_hash creation at my.telegram.org.
mcp_notes: Composio catalog lists a Telegram toolkit (TELEGRAM, 18 tools, API_KEY). No official Telegram-vendor MCP found on core.telegram.org; ecosystem is community MCP servers (e.g. mcp-telegram wrapping MTProto, timoncool/telegram-api-mcp covering all 169 Bot API methods).
uncertainty_notes: 'custom' auth entry refers to the MTProto client API (api_id/api_hash + phone-number login), a non-REST custom protocol not representable in the protocol enum; the mainstream integration surface is the HTTPS Bot API. Bot API is broad within messaging (messages, chats, media, polls, payments, stickers, inline, business features) but bots cannot read arbitrary user chats.

evidence.note: 'Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created'; all queries over HTTPS to api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD; setWebhook delivers updates via HTTPS POST with optional X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header.
'message @BotFather on Telegram to register your bot and receive its authentication token' — free, instant, self-serve.
BotFather /newbot flow generates the auth token; /token regenerates it.
Catalog lists Telegram toolkit (TELEGRAM, API_KEY auth).
Prominent community MCP server (MTProto userbot, 181 tools); no vendor-official MCP exists.
